chapter_notes: No statement names a compound acting on a receptor or enzyme in a stated direction, so there are no records. Skipped 6 statements whose targets are neither receptor nor enzyme (DNA synthesis interference by cyclophosphamide, covalent binding of nitrogen mustard to amino acids/proteins/DNA, NF-kB activation by acrolein/nitrogen mustard, acrolein blocking or enhancing NF-kB, anti-IL-10 and anti-TGF-beta antibodies, anti-IL-12 antibodies). Speculative NADPH oxidase and protein kinase C remarks name no compound-direction pair and were not recorded. PDF page 171 holds acknowledgments then the reference list; page 172 is references only.
